    The replacement projective after socle rejection #

    For a non-simple primitive projective-injective eA, this file realizes eA / soc(eA) as an indecomposable projective over the literal quotient algebra A / soc(eA). Projectivity is proved directly in the annihilated ambient full subcategory; indecomposability follows from preservation of the simple top.
